description: The operator agent drove the checkout flow and left notarizable evidence.

agent.brief: Perform the checkout flow end to end with your own tools (browser automation, HTTP calls, or the platform's UI driver). Complete one full purchase for a trial user, then write a plain-text transcript of every step and response to .testkit/scratch/checkout-transcript.md. The transcript must show the order confirmation. TestKit injects TESTKIT_FAKE_NOW / X-Testkit-Fake-Now into everything it drives; honor it if your flow touches time.
